To navigate this volatile period, **immediately assess and diversify your emergency food and essential supply reserves**, **review and reinforce contingency plans for physical infrastructure against seismic events**, and **proactively monitor evolving international regulations on AI and regional geopolitical shifts to protect strategic investments and operational continuity.**
